name: PokerClubHub
long_description:
TL;DR: PokerClubHub is the first licensed poker club platform. We protect players’ deposits and allow anyone to open their own poker club and make money.

Regulated online poker sites like PokerStars have open player pools and thus are full of pros and bots, driving players to unregulated private clubs.

Existing poker club platforms like ClubGG have no payments processing. Players deposit with a club owner by sending them crypto for play-money chips. In theory, these chips can be exchanged back for money. However, players can get scammed and withdrawing takes ages.

This model is also broken for honest club owners who have to manually process hundreds of deposits a day. They lose out on rake when they sleep and struggle to get players to trust them.

On PokerClubhub, players deposit with PokerClubHub, not the club owner. We handle all deposits and withdrawals for the club owner, saving them time and increasing their earnings. We pay the rake (if any) to club owners as affiliate fees.

We hold the same gaming license as BetHog (built by founders of FanDuel) and Nexa Poker (part of World Poker Tour). Player deposits are secured using Fireblocks.

You can also play rake-free games with your friends and acquaintances on our platform. We ensure that everyone pays up.

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** PokerClubHub is the first licensed poker club platform. We protect players’ deposits and allow anyone to open their own poker club and make money.\
\
[https://drive.google.com/file/d/15qCencYd92aBcZdMjZxykUytkduYrGIb](https://drive.google.com/file/d/15qCencYd92aBcZdMjZxykUytkduYrGIb/view?usp=sharing)

**♣️ Problem**:

Regulated online poker sites like PokerStars have open player pools and thus are full of pros and bots, driving players to unregulated private clubs.

Existing poker club platforms like ClubGG have no payments processing. Players deposit with a club owner by sending them crypto for play-money chips. In theory, these chips can be exchanged back for money. However, players often get scammed and withdrawals are regularly delayed.

This model is also broken for honest club owners who have to manually process hundreds of deposits a day. They lose out on rake when they sleep and struggle to get players to trust them.

**Solution:**

**Players deposit with PokerClubHub, not the club owner.** We handle all deposits and withdrawals for the club owner, saving them time and increasing their earnings. We return the rake to club owners as affiliate fees.

We hold the same gaming license as BetHog (built by founders of FanDuel) and Nexa Poker (part of World Poker Tour). Player deposits are secured using Fireblocks.

You can also play rake-free games with your friends and acquaintances on our platform. We ensure that everyone pays up.

**Our ask:**

Please play some cards on [www.pokerclubhub.com](http://www.pokerclubhub.com). Sign up using code: “LAUNCH” and receive up to $40.

Contact us at [support@pokerclubhub.com](mailto:support@pokerclubhub.com) if you’re a club owner and interested in starting a club on our platform.

If you know anyone in iGaming, we’d love to chat to them! ([ivan@pokerclubhub.com](mailto:ivan@pokerclubhub.com))

**Why we built PokerClubHub:**

1\. To stop players from getting scammed

2\. All the value in poker is created by players but too much of it accrues to a handful of companies. We think clubs, where hosts build communities and share in the economics, are healthier for the ecosystem.
